scope: Governance USER review bundle context-only packet repair and PR2 review-churn closure
purpose: Prevent PR #311 review from acting as the first adversarial parser by proving all ten Connector findings through source-copy identity, support-authority, support-state, and executable-fixture families before another review request.
reference_effectiveness_note: The first repair reference set covered the five original literal examples but was ineffective against sibling repository text suffixes, benign authority-verb targets, packet-level authority placement, keywordless non-Stage-1 state, and dead fixture control flow. This matrix expands each reference into generated and sibling variants and binds the live ten-comment corpus to executable local proof.
root_cause_receipt_marker: PR #311 USER Review Bundle Review-Churn Root-Cause Receipt

root_cause_receipts.root_cause: PR Readiness Stage 1 and the first same-PR repair used literal examples and validator green as family-completion evidence. They did not inventory all Git-normalized repository text suffixes, distinguish authority verbs by gated target, scan support-authority claims across every generated packet surface, validate support state independently of optional planning prose, or prove that the nested direct-authority assertions actually executed.
root_cause_receipts.prevention_summary: PR #311 now uses a four-family Review-Comment Pattern Matrix, exact live comment counts, generated mutation and sibling replay, executable regression cardinality, packet-wide authority scanning, state-first validation, repository-format text identity, and a local pre-PR Connector simulation before any later review request.
preventive_changes: dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py classifies the repository's .vbs, .pyw, and .svg sources as Git-normalized text while preserving opaque binary exactness.
dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py ties direct authority verbs to USER-gated targets and scans support-authority claims across every generated packet surface.
dev/orin_user_review_bundle.py validates generated state markers before optional branch-planning prose can trigger an early return.

dev/orin_user_review_bundle_false_green_fixture_validation.py executes all 30 direct subject/verb cases and replays text identity, benign guidance, packet-surface, fenced-state, and keywordless-state siblings.
dev/orin_pr_review_churn_validation.py classifies all ten PR #311 comments into four precise families while retaining false-positive guardrails.
